root.label: Biden grants Fauci unconditional pre-emptive pardon

events.label: Biden grants Fauci unconditional pre-emptive pardon

slots.name: pardon status
slots.sentence: On his last day in office, Mr. Biden issued Dr. Fauci, and others, an unconditional “pre-emptive pardon ” that protects him from federal prosecution for his actions from 2014 through Jan. 19, 2025.
